candidate.title: TCR-LA-MC PCR
candidate.scope: The assigned single, linear TCR ligation-anchored-magnetically captured PCR (TCR-LA-MC PCR) overview, from TCR RNA through constant-gene-primed biotinylated cDNA, magnetic capture, ssLC ligation and nested PCR to an indexed Illumina-compatible DNA library. TCR alpha and beta are analyte classes within this target. The paper supports the shown architecture and a MiSeq adapter interface; its 454 implementation, comparison assays and unshown adaptations are outside this extraction. No separate alpha/beta branches, pooling, chain-pairing workflow or single-cell compartment route is depicted. The final endpoint is sequence-ready DNA, so sequencing and computational analysis are interpreted as readout capabilities, not added operations.
